Enum Class PriceSource

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PriceSource>
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.PriceSource
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PriceSource>, Constable
public enum PriceSource extends Enum<PriceSource>
Identifies where a PriceQuote came from, so every number in a cost estimate or savings calculation is traceable to its origin and disclaimed appropriately.

Provenance matters because the SDK blends authoritative Equinix pricing (from the live Fabric Pricing API) with reference and customer-supplied figures that the SDK cannot validate. On the trust spectrum: EQUINIX_LIVE and CUSTOM are trustworthy for what they cover; PROVIDER_API is live and accurate for the cloud-provider side but is public list pricing, not a negotiated rate; and REFERENCE/ESTIMATE are indicative only. COMPOSITE inherits the trust of whatever it aggregated — consult the quote's note and the surrounding disclaimer.
